title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (18/20): The Death of Grandmother Jia
note_en: 身体一天不如一天 "her health got worse by the day" uses 一天不如一天, literally "each day is not as good as the day before." Compare 一年比一年少 "less every year" from episode 13: the 比 pattern can describe change in any direction, while 不如 always means things are getting worse. English just says "worse and worse" or "by the day."
